<br class="wixui-rich-text__text">
​3 Day = 27.000php&nbsp; </span></span></span></p>

<p class="font_7 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:14px; text-align:center;"><span style="color:#000000;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:poppins-extralight,poppins,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-size:14px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Zero - Hero Kiteboard Course<br class="wixui-rich-text__text">
